retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 10 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1361516827, argues the convention out of the 1995 call by the UNEP Governing Council and relates it to the Rotterdam and Basel conventions; this atlas holds none of the three. It falls in the same hole as the Montreal Protocol and the Paris Agreement, and until this atlas holds one environmental record that a person has argued, an environmental treaty has nothing here to be joined to.
